Traditional fundraising typically demands substantial initial investments, posing significant risks for investors and minimal accountability for founders. Orbit revolutionizes this approach by using smart contracts to allocate funds based on monthly burn rates instead of large, upfront sums. This method ensures safer, more intelligent funding, with smart contracts that adjust in real-time.
Key Features:
- AI-Powered Insights: Our AI optimizes burn rate and analyzes financial & operational data to ensure burn rate calculations are accurate and up-to-date. 

- Smart Fund Management: AI-driven forecasts help optimize disbursement schedules, ensuring companies receive exactly what they need when they need it.

- Investor Protection: AI detects threats and prevents fraud in real-time.
If conditions are not met, funds remain secure in escrow, minimizing risks.
This integration of AI and blockchain ensures that companies stay on track, and investors enjoy unparalleled security and insights. Have more questions? Contact Us to learn how Orbit’s AI-powered smart contracts can work for you!
Every financial interaction and progress update is permanently documented providing a transparent record of project progress. Orbit's dashboards leverage this data-rich history, providing investors and stakeholders with real-time access to detailed, verifiable project insights. This open and clear documentation not only enhances tracking but also boosts confidence by showcasing accountability and progress at every step.
Key Features:
- Immutable Records: Blockchain ensures that all actions are permanently recorded, making data unalterable and reliable.

- AI-Enhanced Monitoring: Our AI constantly reviews and flags potential discrepancies, providing proactive insights into project health.

- Predictive Transparency: AI doesn’t just track progress—it predicts potential challenges, helping both founders and investors make informed decisions.
With Orbit, transparency is powered by both technology and insight. Our system fosters stronger relationships and better outcomes for founders and investors alike.
